$comment: Applied over the Code - OSS product.json before gulp runs, by
scripts/build-vscode-oss.sh. Doing it at build time rather than patching the
packaged tree afterwards means the values are baked in wherever the build
inlines them, not just where a later regex happened to reach.
assets/server.js rewrites product.json again at every start, and that is
where extensionsGallery is set -- deliberately there and not here. At build
time the gallery named in product.json is where the bundled js-debug
extensions are downloaded from, and pointing that at Open VSX broke the
build: it serves repackaged copies, and the checksums product.json pins no
longer match them. Left unset, the download goes to each extension's own
So do not add extensionsGallery to "set". It was there once and getting it
back out cost three build attempts, because this overlay is applied with
update() and a reused work volume kept serving the key that had already been
removed from the file -- see the Branding stage in build-vscode-oss.sh.
What is true of both: server.js merges shallowly, so a nested object it
names replaces the built one wholesale. Nothing here may rely on a nested
